parsed.rationale: Both participating records live under `Tests/` directories — `Shared/Metadata/Tests/MetadataTests/DiscogsMarkupParserTests.swift` and `WXYC/iOS/Tests/WXYCTests/DiscogsFormatterTests.swift` — and the shared type name `MockDiscogsEntityResolver` carries the `Mock` prefix, the canonical Swift test-double naming convention. Each test target independently defines a local mock for `DiscogsEntityResolver` scoped to its own test suite (`MetadataTests` and `WXYCTests` respectively). Consolidating these into a shared mock would couple two otherwise independent test targets and risk leaking test-only infrastructure into a shared production package. The duplication is intentional test-fixture isolation, not an accidental copy.
